decisions.justification: Directly redundant with existing syn_office_x_transit which already captures this interaction pattern.
Useful office-to-cafe ratio concept but should incorporate spatial context from neighboring hexes to avoid false positives.
Strong concept but needs normalized inputs and should use arrivals not departures for midday presence.
Specialty cafes close before evening rush; existing vibrancy_index already captures this with better methodology.
Misleading name (not coworking-specific), triple multiplication yields sparse output, and largely redundant with commercial_intensity.
Good concept but fillna(1) masks data gaps; should use explicit missing handling and narrower age band.
Captures live-work-play zones with all-day demand; no direct redundancy and low implementation risk.
Arbitrary magic numbers undermine validity; existing wp_pop provides more rigorous workplace population estimates.
Minimal value over raw hdb_resale_4r_median_psm; fails in non-HDB premium areas like CBD.
Actionable signal for transit-node site selection; sparse but high-value where non-zero; no redundancy.
